# Plain Metal's alpha to coverage on an Apple M3 Max under macOS 27.0.1, read by our own probe
# (metal2vulkan-conformance/probes/alpha_coverage_sweep.m) over runtime_lane::alpha_coverage's sweep
# drawn the lane's way, at every sample count the device offers (1, 2 and 4): each alpha fills its
# own 4x4 block of a 128x128 RGBA16Float target, the block's top-left pixel at even coordinates. A
# line is the sample count, the alpha's f32 bits and the block's 16 counts of covered samples, row
# by row, base 36.
